symbols.name: first contraction
symbols.meaning: The linear contraction from length-$s$ to length-$t$ vectors, equal to $S'$ on this page.
symbols.quote: where $A$ is a linear map from length-$s$ to length-$t$ vectors and $B_0$ is a linear map from length-$t$ to length-$s$ vectors.

symbols.name: second contraction
symbols.meaning: The linear contraction from length-$t$ to length-$s$ vectors, equal to $D'J'C$ on this page.
symbols.quote: where $A$ is a linear map from length-$s$ to length-$t$ vectors and $B_0$ is a linear map from length-$t$ to length-$s$ vectors.

symbols.name: generic length-t vector
symbols.meaning: A generic vector of $t$ coordinates, the input of the permutation $P_t$.
symbols.quote: Here $v$ is a generic length-$t$ vector, not the second integer of radix-digit convolution.

symbols.name: scaled gathering map
symbols.meaning: The map $S/2$, the gathering map $S$ scaled by one half.

symbols.name: scaled inverse
symbols.meaning: The map $N^{-1}/2$, the inverse of $N$ scaled by one half.

symbols.name: scaled diagonal map
symbols.meaning: The diagonal map $D$ multiplied by the normalization $2^{-(2\alpha^2-2)}$.

symbols.name: identity map
symbols.meaning: The identity map on length-$s$ vectors, which leaves every vector unchanged.

relations.quote: It is obtained by inverting the [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md) identity, which keeps both permutations.
The two maps are linear contractions, bounded in the [operator norm](operator-norm.md) by one, meaning each sends a vector to one of norm at most its input norm.
